items.title: Controlling Reasoning Effort in LLMs
items.content: How LLMs Learn Low-, Medium-, and High-Effort Reasoning Modes
items.contentSnippet: How LLMs Learn Low-, Medium-, and High-Effort Reasoning Modes

summaries.zh: 本文探讨了大型语言模型如何习得低、中、高三种不同努力程度的推理模式，并实现对推理深度的控制。核心内容围绕模型在推理过程中动态调节计算资源的能力展开，揭示了如何引导模型根据任务需求选择恰当的思考模式，以平衡准确性与效率。
summaries.en: The article discusses how large language models (LLMs) can be trained to adopt distinct reasoning modes—low, medium, and high effort—allowing control over the computational intensity of their responses. It addresses the methods by which models learn to modulate their reasoning depth depending on the required task.

items.title: Recent Developments in LLM Architectures: KV Sharing, mHC, and Compressed Attention
items.content: From Gemma 4 to DeepSeek V4, How New Open-Weight LLMs Are Reducing Long-Context Costs
items.contentSnippet: From Gemma 4 to DeepSeek V4, How New Open-Weight LLMs Are Reducing Long-Context Costs

summaries.zh: 近期大型语言模型架构研究聚焦于降低长上下文计算成本，主要方向包括KV缓存共享、多头循环注意力（mHC）和压缩注意力等机制。以Gemma 4和DeepSeek V4为代表的新型开源权重模型，正在通过这些技术优化长序列处理的效率。
summaries.en: Open-weight large language models like Gemma 4 and DeepSeek V4 are adopting novel architectural techniques to lower the computational cost of processing long contexts. Key innovations include KV cache sharing, which reduces memory overhead by reusing key-value states; multi-head attention variants (mHC) that improve efficiency; and compressed attention mechanisms that condense long sequences. These methods collectively cut inference costs while maintaining performance on extended inputs.

items.title: Components of A Coding Agent
items.content: How coding agents use tools, memory, and repo context to make LLMs work better in practice
items.contentSnippet: How coding agents use tools, memory, and repo context to make LLMs work better in practice

summaries.zh: 文章介绍了编码代理的关键组成部分：工具、记忆和代码库上下文。这些组件帮助大语言模型在实际编程中更有效地工作，工具可执行操作，记忆保留历史信息，代码库上下文提供项目全局理解，从而提升模型的任务处理能力与实用性。
summaries.en: Coding agents improve the real-world performance of large language models by incorporating three core components: tools, memory, and repository context. Tools enable the agent to execute actions like running code or searching docs. Memory retains past interactions for coherent, ongoing tasks. Repository context gives the agent awareness of the existing codebase structure and files. These elements work together to produce more accurate, context-aware code generation and problem-solving.

items.content: From MHA and GQA to MLA, sparse attention, and hybrid architectures

summaries.en: This article presents a visual overview of attention mechanisms used in contemporary large language models. It covers multi-head attention (MHA), grouped-query attention (GQA), multi-latent attention (MLA), sparse attention approaches, and hybrid architectures, illustrating how these variants evolve to balance efficiency and performance.
